item.title: How to automate Shiny
item.description: I've been having problems with a project I'm working on... I want to be able to run a script on RStudio everytime new data is entered on an excel sheet, so it can be analysed. I also want my shiny app to show the analysis results automatically on a website. The thing is, I want all of that to happen without having to open RStudio. Is that possible?
